context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 176 verified ALL 49 tests pass covering the complete historical scoring allocation engine. Key test files: test_complete_history.py (21 tests with League helper class for complete seeding), test_game_allocation.py (18 pre-seeded tests), test_api_flow_allocation.py (10 API-flow tests). The engine correctly handles: fixed roster scoring, trade 10/6 splits (fpts + roto), drop preserves stats, pickup after drop gap excluded, drop+reacquire, active-to-bench exclusion, bench-to-active exclusion, corrections to original owner, multiple trades, recomputation idempotent, finalization, finalized history survives trade, waiver pickup, backfill engine, and uncertainty flagging.

fixed_roster_scoring.details: 5 games x 2 goals = 10 goals correctly allocated

trade_10_6_split_fpts.details: Player scores 10 goals (5 games) on Team A, traded, scores 6 goals (3 games) on Team B. Result: A=5 games, B=3 games

trade_10_6_split_roto.details: Roto stats follow same ownership split: A=10 goals, B=6 goals

drop_preserves_earlier_earnings.details: Team A's stats unchanged when player is dropped

pickup_after_drop_excludes_unowned_gap.details: Games during unowned interval (Jan 8-9) not credited to either team

drop_and_reacquire_preserves_stats.details: Both ownership intervals preserved, earlier stats retained

active_to_bench_excludes_stats.details: Games while player on bench are excluded from scoring

correction_applies_to_original_owner.details: Correction to pre-trade game changes Team A, not Team B

multiple_trades_split.details: A->B at Jan 8, B->C at Jan 10: A=3, B=2, C=2 games

recomputation_is_idempotent.details: Running allocation 3 times produces identical results

finalization_stores_correct_split.details: After trade, finalization stores A:5 games, B:3 games

finalized_history_survives_trade.details: Post-period trade doesn't affect week 1 allocation

waiver_pickup_scores.details: A drops Jan 7, B picks up Jan 8: A=2 games, B=4 games

retroactive_ownership_creation.details: log_roster_change creates retroactive closed period from league season start when no open span exists

backfill_engine.details: Backfill reconstructs ownership periods from trade records and activity feed

backfill_is_idempotent.details: Running backfill twice produces same number of ownership periods

fallback_flags_uncertain.details: When no ownership data and no backfill, results flagged uncertain=true, needs_backfill=true

admin_backfill_endpoint.details: POST /api/admin/platform/backfill-ownership/69e46af167999bfb85c39628 - 200 OK (377 ownership periods, 279 lineup periods)
